title: Decoupling Error Attribution in Cloud-Native Graph-RAG: A Data Integrity Diagnostic Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.13324v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph-RAG systems often assume pristine data quality, overlooking the severe impact of perturbations in cloud-native databases. This paper proposes a three-layer decoupled diagnostic framework to orthogonally attribute system errors to reasoning loss, Knowledge Graph (KG) defects, and Cypher generation errors. Evaluated on a spatio-temporal ecological KG of the Southeastern Tibet region with eight defect types, results reveal that data integrity, rather than algorithmic reasoning, is the dominant performance bottleneck, with structural defects degrading system accuracy from 0.93 to 0.39. Crucially, we observe a masking-like phenomenon termed the Parametric Knowledge Masking Effect (PKME), suggesting LLMs compensate for broken retrieval paths using internal memory. This shrinks apparent query generation errors by over 70 percent, obscuring actual storage deterioration and increasing the risk of false negatives for automated monitoring.

translated_title: 云原生Graph-RAG中的解耦错误归因：一种数据完整性诊断框架
translated_abstract: Graph-RAG系统通常假设数据质量完美无缺，忽视了云原生数据库中扰动带来的严重影响。本文提出了一种三层解耦诊断框架，将系统错误正交归因于推理损失、知识图谱（KG）缺陷和Cypher生成错误。在藏东南地区的时空生态知识图谱上，针对八种缺陷类型进行评估，结果表明数据完整性而非算法推理才是主导性能瓶颈，结构性缺陷使系统准确率从0.93下降至0.39。关键的是，我们观察到一种类似掩蔽的现象，称为参数知识掩蔽效应（PKME），表明大语言模型（LLMs）会利用内部记忆来补偿断裂的检索路径。这使得表面上的查询生成错误减少了70%以上，掩盖了实际的数据存储恶化，并增加了自动化监控产生假阴性结果的风险。
tldr: 本文提出一种三层解耦诊断框架，将云原生Graph-RAG系统错误正交归因于推理损失、知识图谱缺陷和Cypher生成错误，发现数据完整性才是主要性能瓶颈，并首次揭示了LLM利用内部记忆补偿断裂检索路径的“参数知识掩蔽效应”（PKME）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-layer decoupled diagnostic framework that orthogonally attributes Graph-RAG errors to reasoning loss, KG defects, and Cypher generation errors, revealing data integrity as the dominant bottleneck and identifying a Parametric Knowledge Masking Effect (PKME) where LLMs compensate for broken retrieval paths with internal memory.
